import math

nav = 866520721
cash = 83625721

holdings = {
    "2059": 4000, "2308": 38000, "2317": 153000, "2330": 59000, "2345": 24000,
    "2368": 28000, "2379": 31000, "2382": 106000, "2383": 9000, "2454": 10000,
    "3017": 11000, "3034": 38000, "3227": 96000, "3260": 76000, "3293": 22000,
    "3661": 8000, "3665": 21000, "3711": 43000, "5289": 23000, "6139": 34000,
    "6223": 4000, "6669": 16000, "7828": 19000, "8046": 26000, "8299": 21000,
    "8415": 465000
}

orders = [
    {"ticker": "2330", "side": "SELL", "shares": 5000, "decision_ref": "D1", "weight": 0.139, "price": 2230},
    {"ticker": "2308", "side": "SELL", "shares": 6000, "decision_ref": "D2", "weight": 0.0401, "price": 1085},
    {"ticker": "2383", "side": "SELL", "shares": 3000, "decision_ref": "D3", "weight": 0.0274, "price": 3395},
    {"ticker": "3711", "side": "SELL", "shares": 14000, "decision_ref": "D4", "weight": 0.0183, "price": 530},
    {"ticker": "2059", "side": "SELL", "shares": 3000, "decision_ref": "D5", "weight": 0.0143, "price": 6200},
    {"ticker": "2379", "side": "SELL", "shares": 31000, "decision_ref": "D6", "weight": 0.0, "price": 694},
    {"ticker": "3034", "side": "SELL", "shares": 38000, "decision_ref": "D7", "weight": 0.0, "price": 435.5},
    {"ticker": "8046", "side": "SELL", "shares": 26000, "decision_ref": "D8", "weight": 0.0, "price": 737},
    {"ticker": "2618", "side": "BUY", "shares": 600000, "decision_ref": "D9", "weight": 0.0337, "price": 48.6},
    {"ticker": "2603", "side": "BUY", "shares": 83000, "decision_ref": "D10", "weight": 0.0249, "price": 257},
]

buy_amt = 0
sell_amt = 0
for o in orders:
    t = o["ticker"]
    cur = holdings.get(t, 0)
    target = math.floor(o["weight"] * nav / o["price"] / 1000) * 1000
    diff = target - cur
    side = "BUY" if diff > 0 else "SELL"
    assert side == o["side"], f"Side mismatch {t}"
    assert abs(diff) == o["shares"], f"Shares mismatch {t}: {abs(diff)} vs {o['shares']}"
    assert o["shares"] % 1000 == 0 and o["shares"] > 0
    if side == "SELL":
        assert o["shares"] <= cur, f"Oversell {t}"
        sell_amt += o["shares"] * o["price"]
    else:
        buy_amt += o["shares"] * o["price"]

new_cash = cash + sell_amt - buy_amt
cash_pct = new_cash / nav
print(f"buy_amt={buy_amt:,.0f}, sell_amt={sell_amt:,.0f}, new_cash={new_cash:,.0f}, cash_pct={cash_pct:.4f}")
print("Buy covered by initial cash alone?", buy_amt <= cash)
